newsitem.title: USA: National Market Exchanges Jan shr volume up 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: National Market Exchanges Jan shr volume up 24 pct.

text.p: Volume levels at the National Market Exchanges (NME) rose by more than 20 percent in January compared to a year ago, the exchanges said on Tuesday.

The NME -- which includes the Boston, Chicago, Philadelphia and Pacific Stock Exchanges -- said combined share volume reached 1,019,368,000 shares, up 24 percent from year-ago levels. Total equity trades for the month rose 21 percent to 1,448,484.
